title: sound.json
description: State for the rain/lofi ambience player. Read and written by the Sound singleton; the audio itself is a long-lived local mpv, driven over its own IPC socket, not through this file.

pools.description: Which local directory backs each playable mode, as declared data. Keys are the mode enum minus "off" (pinned in lockstep by sound.test.js); "$HOME/..." is resolved by Sound.qml, since JSON cannot expand environment.

mode.description: Which local playlist is loaded. "off" means mpv is idle/stopped.

track.description: Absolute path of the currently loaded file, or null when mode is "off".
